articles.headline: Western Sydney Wanderers decry policing at A-League games: 'Enough is enough'
articles.description: Western Sydney Wanderers chair Paul Lederer has hit out at what he has said is "totally unacceptable" policing of his club's supporters, labelling it excessive and declaring that "enough is enough."

images.name: Awer Mabil scores the match winner for Melbourne City
images.caption: For the first time in over 11 years, Awer Mabil has scored an A-League goal, sealing the victory over Sydney FC.

articles.headline: A-Leagues' financial woes: How solvent is Australia's top tier?
